key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 80-85% estimated (FTP 20% + govt profit oil 85% on oil tranche + CIT 44-48% on contractor share).
No fixed ceiling — costs recovered from production after FTP; effective recovery ~40-60% of gross.

Oil base: 57% govt / 43% contractor. Gas base: 52% govt / 48% contractor. Variable adjustments per MEMR Reg 8/2017: location (+0 to +19%), reservoir depth (+0 to +1.5%), infrastructure (+0 to +2%), CO2 content (+0 to +10%), H2S (+0 to +1%), API gravity (+0 to +4%).
44-48% effective (deemed profit basis per PSC contract-specific rate). General CIT 22% but oil PSC contractors subject to contract-specific rate.
Oil: 15% contractor / 85% government. Gas: 30% contractor / 70% government. Standard Indonesian cost-recovery PSC split.
N/A — FTP mechanism: 20% of gross production off-top before cost recovery.
No royalty — replaced by FTP (First Tranche Petroleum) 20% of gross production taken by State.
No NOC equity in standard cost-recovery PSC. SKK Migas supervises. Pertamina took 100% on expiry of Total/Inpex PSC Dec 31, 2017.
